newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow in light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow in light test - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test.
Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 1,000 heifers, following weekly movement of 70,400 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
66.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs
Confirmed - 2,000 Week Ago - 3,000 Year Ago - None
